options.label: Grid, two lines a row
options.notes: Each build with its PR and branch under it, attempts split by kind (merge / fix / land), the last decision under the result. Best on a wide screen.

options.label: Cards
options.notes: One card per build with state, attempts and last result as labels and values; reads best on a phone.

options.label: Compact grid, one line a row
options.notes: One line per build: state, attempt count and the last result; fits the most builds on screen.
